description: Implementation of a text-to-speech (TTS) service class for Piper, integrating with Piper's HTTP TTS server, supporting streaming audio generation and metrics.

classes.name: PiperTTSService
classes.description: A class implementing a TTS service that interfaces with Piper's HTTP TTS server, supporting streaming synthesis and metrics.

methods.name: can_generate_metrics
methods.description: Checks if the service supports metrics generation, returning True.

methods.name: run_tts
methods.description: Asynchronously generates speech audio frames from input text via Piper's HTTP API, yielding status and audio frames, with error handling.
